protocol.source: Warp-MPM V2 (v2main) head on frozen V-JEPA2 ViT-L cached features, model C (aux fields, no feedback), best_material.pt
protocol.target: libuipc 0.0.29 StableNeoHookean FEM, BDF1, cantilever tip load ramp-hold-release, 3 views x 64 frames 224px
protocol.target_space: ln1p(E/(rho/1000)) standardized with MPM v2main train stats; nu standardized likewise (metrics reported raw)

engcond.conditioning: learned engine embedding added to frozen pooled representation + per-engine output affine (lnE, nu)

protocol.model_selection: none: fixed schedules chosen a priori; val is used only for reporting

resimulation_check.protocol:
V3a sanity check: re-simulate uipc val cases with PREDICTED (E, nu) and compare to the observed motion. For N val cases (first N/2 of each val geometry, by sample id) and each arm, the predicted E and nu from
docs/v3a/UIPC_FEWSHOT.json (one source seed) replace the ground truth in the case; everything else (mesh,
load schedule, solver) is unchanged. Error vs the observed uipc surface trajectory (traj.npz):
  disp_err_m      mean over frames and surface nodes of |u_pred - u_obs|
  disp_err_rel    disp_err_m / mean |u_obs|
  tip_rmse_px     RMSE of the mean tip y displacement, in side-view pixels
Each simulation runs in its own subprocess with a timeout; failures are recorded, never dropped.
'oracle' re-simulates with the ground-truth (E, nu) (solver repeatability floor).
